blind.description: A stylized wooden wall-mounted rack or shelf featuring a backboard, two vertical side posts, and three curved support corbels underneath. Resting along the top shelf surface is a row of five dark metal kettle-hat helmets with pointed crowns and flared circular brims. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous, with warm reddish-brown wood and metallic grey steel textures. The asset is designed to be mounted on a wall rather than resting flat on a floor.
blind.from_above: A horizontal rectangular wooden frame containing a neat row of five circular grey metallic helmet domes, each with a centered conical peak.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 the height of the figure (around 1.2 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 ft wide, roughly half the figure's total height.
